280:3971.en: 「If I destroy the $$インプラント$$ device!」

280:4149.en: 「How can I stop his $$インプラント$$...!」

280:4219.en: 「I know exactly what the V9 can do!」

280:4252.en: 「I'll stop you before you control\nthe $$バジュラ$$ directly, no matter what!」

280:4301.en: 「Are you people trying\nto take over the galaxy!?」

280:4503.en: 「We nearly ended up violating\nthe Galactic Treaty ourselves...!」

280:4562.en: 「So I was stuck thinking within\nthe bounds of common sense too...!」

280:4629.en: 「If we can at least\ncommunicate with them...!」

280:5086.en: 「This is $$スカル$$ 3!\n$$アンタレス$$ 1, I'll cover you!」

280:5137.en: 「Those moves... Just as I thought,\nno normal human could do that...!」

280:5219.en: 「$$アンタレス$$ 1, please leave this to me!」

285:48.en: 「I'll crush all who get in my way!」

285:114.en: 「So much hate...!\nIt's welling up from deep inside me!」

285:167.en: 「You can all just die!\nLet everything be destroyed!」

285:348.en: 「Anything will do! Let me destroy it!」

285:379.en: 「If it's come to this, I'll wreck\nanything I can get my hands on!」

285:428.en: 「Everything I lay eyes on\nis a target of my hatred!」

286:87.en: 「Move!\nIf you don't wanna die, get lost!」

286:175.en: 「Just die, all of you!\nThis whole world can go to hell!」

286:304.en: 「I said stay out of my sight!」

286:347.en: 「I don't care who you are,\njust make this rage stop!」

286:400.en: 「I'll wreck you! You and that one...!」

286:439.en: 「Don't you get it?\nI said get out of the way!」

286:494.en: 「Something pitch-black in my gut\nkeeps welling up more and more!」

287:11.en: 「Out of my way! I'll destroy it all!」

287:83.en: 「It won't stop!\nI can't stop the hatred inside me!」

287:179.en: 「Everybody, just die!\nI don't need a world like this!」

287:238.en: 「Move!\nAnyone in my way is my enemy!」

287:287.en: 「What is this!?\nWhat's going to happen to me!?」

287:340.en: 「I'm burning up! So this is... hate!」

287:412.en: 「I hate it all! Everything I see!」

287:451.en: 「Move!\nWhy do you keep getting in my way!?」

288:11.en: 「Damn you! Stay out of my way!」

288:85.en: 「Shut up!\nDon't you make a fool of me!」

288:136.en: 「Dammit!\nI hate it so much I can't stand it!」

288:216.en: 「Try to stop me and you're my enemy!」

288:366.en: 「I don't care anymore!\nI said just disappear!」

289:50.en: 「Whoever gets in my way, I destroy!」

289:89.en: 「I told you not to get in my way!」

289:122.en: 「Ahh, I hate it! The whole world!」

289:206.en: 「If you're standing there,\nyou must want to die!」

289:257.en: 「From my gut, from deep in my head,\nhatred is seeping out!」

289:312.en: 「Who knew giving in to hatred\ncould feel this good...!」

289:373.en: 「Soon it'll all break apart!\nThe world, and me with it!」

289:463.en: 「Who cares anymore! Let it all break!」

289:500.en: 「If it's come to this, I'll spit out\neverything I've kept inside!!」
